findings.meaning: Runs whatever a remote server returns, with no review.
findings.remediation: pin a version and verify a checksum; avoid `curl … | sh` in install hooks and scripts
findings.title: Download-and-execute (pipe to shell)

findings.meaning: pull_request_target/workflow_run runs with secrets + write token; checking out the PR head lets attackers run code with them.
findings.remediation: use `pull_request` (read-only token) or stop checking out the PR head in `pull_request_target`
findings.title: gha-pwn-request: privileged trigger checks out untrusted PR code

findings.meaning: Secrets written to logs or files can leak.
findings.remediation: stop echoing secrets; rely on masking and scope `env:` to the step that needs it
findings.title: gha-secret-echo: secret printed in a workflow step

findings.meaning: Tags can be moved to malicious code (e.g. tj-actions/changed-files, 2025).
findings.remediation: pin `uses:` to a full 40-character commit SHA
findings.title: gha-unpinned-action: 1 action(s) on a tag/branch, not a commit SHA

findings.meaning: Tags can be moved to malicious code (e.g. tj-actions/changed-files, 2025).
findings.remediation: pin `uses:` to a full 40-character commit SHA
findings.title: gha-unpinned-action: 1 action(s) on a tag/branch, not a commit SHA

findings.meaning: A compromised step can push code or publish packages.
findings.remediation: add a least-privilege `permissions:` block to the workflow
findings.title: gha-write-permissions: workflow token has write permissions

findings.meaning: CI runs whatever the remote server returns, with CI secrets available.
findings.remediation: download to a file, verify a checksum, then execute it (avoid `curl … | sh` in workflows)
findings.title: gha-curl-pipe-shell: workflow pipes a download into a shell

findings.meaning: Runs with repository secrets on events from forks; review carefully.
findings.remediation: prefer `pull_request`, and check who can push to `workflow_run` upstream branches
findings.title: gha-privileged-trigger: workflow uses workflow_run
